title: 八角奏乐亭 Ba Jiao Zou Yue Ting
subtitle: east octagonal music pavilion · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Modelled from the plates of 1783-86 (plates 1 and 2, the south and north fronts), Ohlmer's photographs of 1873 from the south, east and north, the plan S01 and the ruin's footprint; every figure is a reading (C) until the Qing drawing 样式雷 985 with its 120 dimensions is seen. The west end, the rear of the colonnades and octagons and the roof's back have no picture: carried round from the documented bays (assumed).
rows: 27.2 × 8.6 m, three storeys: ground storey to 3.9 m, main storey cornice 8.7 m, top storey cornice 11.6 m, ridge 14 m (plates 1-2, P0187-P0189, C)
7, 7 and 3 (S108, S310, B); the ends a door between two cartouches (P0188, B as photographed, C carried to the west end)
two quarter ellipses of 9 bays from the block's flanks (S01's traces, B), 4 m deep, cornice at 3.9 m, one level with the block's ground storey and the octagons' lower cornice (S108 Fig. 8, B)
two octagons 8.7 m across, 61.8 m apart (S850, B), cornices 3.9 and 7.4 m, apex 10 m (plate 1, C)
a landing at 3.9 m, a flight down either side of it to a curved terrace at 1.9 m over the pool (plate 1, P0186, P0187), flights at the terrace's ends running out to the court (plate 1 only, C, Q220)
south 海棠 pool 27.3 × 13.2 m (S01, C) with the fish 翻尾石鱼 (S840, B); north basin 4.5 m across (S310, B)
white stone, grey wall panels, blue-green windows, a yellow-ochre glazed roof with an orange-red edge (the unfinished watercolour of plate 1, S700, C)

Ohlmer's photographs of 1873: 0.3-0.6 m rms at the building over 64 points (P0185-P0189); plate 2: 1.3 m; plate 1: 1.6 m once its heights, drawn 1.57 times its widths, are allowed for (Q219). research/xiyanglou/plate_fit_XY01.csv
on the photographs, the plan's frontage as the scale: the plates draw the top storey half as tall again (Q219)

searched: No text or drawing names it in 日下旧闻考 j83, the Qianlong poems on Kanripo, Delatour 1803, Malone 1934, the witnesses of 1860, what search indexes show of the Yangshi Lei drawings.

photos.title: Gezicht op de ruïnes van een deel van het Zomerpaleis, Gezicht op een water bij Peking, Gezicht op de weg naar het Zomerpaleis en Gezicht op een deel van het Zomerpaleis
photos.creator: unknown, autotypes in a book
photos.why: Top-left plate: octagonal pavilion with columns, as P0185. Bottom-right plate: arched gate with two niches, as XY05 east in P0175. Bottom-right plate is not the east gate of 养雀笼: flat-headed door gap between two oval cartouches, piers and balustraded parapet, the east end of 谐奇趣 as P0188 and P0165. XY05 east has an arch and two niches (P0175, P0192).
photos.visible: top-left plate, printed PAVILLON EUROPÉEN: octagon, ground storey columns, framed panel, upper storey with cartouches
